notes.title: BOOMSTOCK 2025 - UPDATE IN OCTOBER
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/5dfa07353dfb5f3c12a5146fe2df45cc1d7dabbd.png"][/img][/p][h2]We are happy to announce a new update for Project: AMICA Demo, coming later in October![/h2][h3]HUB, Polish & More Asset![/h3][p][/p][p]The upcoming HUB update is right around the corner, featuring fast travel between areas, more collectables, overall polish and more assets. The HUB is still early in development and we are looking into how we can cram in as much potential as possible into the HUB. It might be a bit empty for now, but if you have any suggestions we'd love to hear em once the update goes live! We'd also love more feedback from new players![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers[/p][p]Jacob[/p][p][i]dofhouse loves you <3[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/443140debd8b0f3b95fdc0d0abcae8fdbc0508e7.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="rEZH2KYG-Lw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Features & HUB Area!
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/a127840cb5b905efe546c217c885533ce7170445.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hey everyone! Jacob from dofhouse here. [/h1][h3]We've been hard at work on the HUB Area and today we'd like to talk about some upcoming stuff![/h3][p][/p][h2]HUB[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/e1cf117f019f92146be5be17fa0d984a870c27ab.png"][/img][/p][p]For our next demo update, we're focusing on implementing the first iteration of a HUB Area in the form of SIDs Spaceship. Here you'll be able to spend some downtime, wind down and relax. The main idea behind this area is to let you take a pause from the action and be able to select previously visited areas from a terminal. It might be a bit empty for now, but we hope to implement more features as we go![/p][p]Since we're going for a metroidvania-esque design with AMICA, being able to teleport to previously visited areas with new equippment is something that we want to explore.[/p][p]One of the things I'm most excited about is the ability to store all collectables at the ship. Like the "dofs" for example. After you've collected a dof, they'll teleport to your ship and roam around there freely. We'll most likely add more features in the future, but for now, this is our main focus for the Ship.[/p][p]We could see the ship being used as a way to stay informed about lore, your current "mission" and a place to interact with future NPC's! Like Jessica-3 & Captain Tapirus :)[/p][p][/p][p]We're also polishing up the jungle with more decorative assets, lighting and more. And there are also bullet casings now! [/p][p][/p][h2]That's pretty much it for now![/h2][h3]We hope to get this update out by late September / early October.[/h3][h1][/h1][p]dofhouse loves you <3 // Jacob[/p]

notes.title: DEMO PATCH 0.1.2 - Holographic Text Decorations, A New Powerup? & "Secrets" Fix
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/a127840cb5b905efe546c217c885533ce7170445.png"][/img][/p][h3]Hey everyone! Jacob from dofhouse here with a small patch for the AMICA demo. [/h3][p]There isn't really any new major content, but we've added some nice scrolling holographic text at certain locations in the game to expand the world building a teeny-tiny bit and to make the maps feel more "alive". Let us know what you think about it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/b9a9742e5eed35490935eda9e47c1647bad90b3d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]NEW POWER-UP![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/c985c8505806a65fa73433fcd8243012ea1c1a99.png"][/img]Yes! You can now find the Bee-Bot Hat in the demo. The bee-bot hat comes with a passive angry bee that attacks enemies in your surroundings, great way of doing some extra damage and also a cute pet <3 [/p][p][/p][h3]You can finally 100% the demo now![/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/915a165eeb365aaddbbfa19749985297cecf90d6.gif"][/img][/h2][p]Apparently, you couldn't find/pick-up all the secrets, now you can![/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/9a9bc5e76fb1652d1c6a24bb705c153a209e1db4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/c056a473f125d1a01a659f0e384e52de15c7e0b8.png"][/img][/h2][p]Also, there are two new dofs to find, happy hunting![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/6c46350cb5106996db7e25be8325d5bc4e09ad7e.png"][/img][/p][h2]Project: AMICA 0.1.2 - Patch notes[/h2][h3]World[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the secrets counter for each of the three demo levels. There should no longer be any inaccessible secrets, meaning you can finally 100% the game![/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the crusty old reused dofs with two fresh new dofs! Can you find them?[/p][/*][*][p]Added in-world hologram signs to indicate transitions between places and areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Jungle and Canyon skyboxes to fit the overall art style better. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons & powerups[/h3][list][*][p]Made hitscan attacks and projectile hitboxes a lot more accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed randomized damage from some of the weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the BeeBot hidden somewhere deep in the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]The punch is now its own permanent ability and won't be replaced by the block powerup. It has also been combined with the interact key, meaning fewer unnecessary keys to keep track of.[/p][/*][*][p]The Siempu-Nura (previously the Launcher) secondary attack flames no longer pass through solid non-damageable objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons work more accurately to the player's view height. This is still in the works and will be improved in the future.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Swapped "Play demo" for "New game" in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Dropped items (such as those from boxes) have a visually improved spawn effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Health packs to the drop pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the pickup message for the basic dof.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem with invisible decorations.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Tweaks![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/9531db6cabe8d361f14d30b67103b907370931ef.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/a32a94b28efb47c977ec101709bb465a1719b1c4.png"][/img][/p][h2]What's that? Ladybug?[/h2][p]Ladybug Equipment AB is a construction, mining and other engineering equipment manufacturer from Mega-Skåne, UFG Nordic Region, Sector SWE. The company is the world's largest manufacturer of construction equipment, and they're working hard on their latest product...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/dae30d8472e3c440aae3539d00d3624756c7d4b5.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]BEA3S[/b]-Gråskruv [i]petit[/i] [/h2][h3](a.k.a. Powerdrill) - [i]we actually just call it powerdrill // dofhouse[/i][/h3][p]We're currently working on a new weapon which will function as a Driller/Flamethrower and be able to destroy rocks so that you don't have to waste rocket ammo. It's not finished yet and you'll most likely be able to find it in the mines when it's in. We're reworking the rocket launcher and its alt-fire since the new Driller weapon sorta overwrites the use for rocket destruction. [/p][p][/p][h2]That's it for this patch![/h2][p]We're still working on the things we mentioned last update, like the new "Roller" enemy type and the reworked weapon designs. Stay tuned for more news to come![/p][p][/p][p]dofhouse loves you <3[/p][p]Jacob [/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 0.1.1 - Fixes, Tweaks, Polish & Changes
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/a127840cb5b905efe546c217c885533ce7170445.png"][/img][/p][h1]Hey everyone! Hope you had a great week. [/h1][h3]A new update is out! We've been working on some of your feedback and general fixes which we'll cover in this post. We're also sharing some upcoming stuff today. Let's see what's new![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/f9beb3b6aed20bfa071e12feee7a77e40bf234f4.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Ammo Loot![/h2][p]Everybody seemed to love smashing the boxes, but aside from a little dopamine kick, there wasn't really any point in doing it. So we added a chance for boxes to drop ammo! More smashing and more bullets, baby![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/0518c25b6853a2f8f3aa989039783704f58e1144.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Flashier Drones![/h2][p]Wow, look at that! Some cool new drone animations as well as new tree and cactus debris and prettier leaf sprites![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/45ffa962dcb5978bd1d590b993c2af785438e485.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Ahh! There it is! (Railgun in The Greenlands)[/h2][p]We noticed that players weren't using the Railgun as much as we'd hoped. Probably because it's pretty well hidden away in the Corebreak Mines. In any case, now you can find the Railgun in the Jungle! You still gotta figure out how to get to it though, so good luck :P[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/ab708be8e1216f25d2b390d0021f08d097ef49bd.gif"][/img][/p][h2]JACKPOT!!![/h2][p]Now there's a flashing little "5x" icon that pops up after hitting 5 enemies in a row with the secondary Railgun attack. All the more satisfaction![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/7a8324772bba2e5a9638dbd82d72a6207f94c2e9.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Text Holograms![/h2][p]To help players understand where they can or can't go, we've added some cool scrolling text holograms to indicate teleporters and WIP areas. There are many routes in AMICA, and after watching your amazing gameplay we realized that we needed some sort of guidance so that you don't end up trying to get into unfinished areas. Let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/4f58229592a5f4252ef1526f38ea90afe20abec1.gif"][/img][/p][h2]Point blank - ACE[/h2][p]When shooting an enemy at point-blank range with the Highwiper (Previously the Blaster, aka the Shotgun), the weapon will flash for a short moment (we call this an "ACE") and do more damage as well as allowing you to quickly fire an extra round.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/0c32ee4ef024ca72474537e8c3c6fd579933adb4.gif"][/img][/p][h2]The "dofs"[/h2][p]Our company mascot, the dof, and his siblings are hidden away throughout the game. They're lost, sad and need your help! Go save them <3[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/6c46350cb5106996db7e25be8325d5bc4e09ad7e.png"][/img][/p][p]Patch notes - Project: AMICA 0.1.1[/p][p][/p][h3]World[/h3][list][*][p]Area transitions no longer reset the level or its automap. This change has temporarily disabled some HUD effects. Improved transitions are in the works however.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some non-lava floors in the Mines would inflict lava damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Lava damage can no longer be 'out-jumped'.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visuals for teleporters to make their function clearer.[/p][/*][*][p]Blocked entry to unfinished areas (Swamp, Factory, Jungle boss arena) because we are evil.[/p][/*][*][p]Aligned lots of level textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved level details in Jungle and Mines.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons & powerups[/h3][list][*][p]The converter secondary attack now has improved animations and effects for the different levels of nanobot damage. Nanobot max damage has also been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]The Highwiper (previously the Blaster) primary attack has been beefed up with more pellets, a tighter spread and higher overall damage. It has also been given a flashing 'Ace'-effect to indicate a point-blank hit, which deals increased damage and lowers reload time.[/p][/*][*][p]The Railgun secondary attack now gives a visual effect when reaching a 5X hit combo.[/p][/*][*][p]All explosions have a decreased damage falloff, making the Launcher primary attack more effective.[/p][/*][*][p]The Jump Boots can no longer cause a ledge boost with their second jump. Again, evil.[/p][/*][*][p]The Railgun can now be found earlier in the demo ;)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sound & music[/h3][list][*][p]Extended the Jungle theme.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved SFX for the Converter.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX to Waterfalls.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX to teleporters.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Big boxes and box piles now have a chance to drop Converter, Highwiper or Railgun ammo.[/p][/*][*][p]Trees now drop debris on death.[/p][/*][*][p]Cacti now have damage animations and also drop debris on death. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated textures for falling leaf effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Puffs and debris are now randomly flipped to give a more varied look.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/9531db6cabe8d361f14d30b67103b907370931ef.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/8de081a72f5046341d76ef6d9eec95bc7938f7b6.png"][/img]We're currently working on multiple new enemy types, like this bad boy! Don't know its name yet, maybe we'll take suggestions? Stupid names only! Anyways, this is not the final design, we'll keep working on it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/f7e19672fcd1360ac904fea5093a1881b61f716f.jpg"][/img]Here's some other concepts! (whoops it's flipped)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/cda3f0d8f4ff7a5a3b011c7c39116ff8ca2938a4.png"][/img]There's also going to be some design changes to all the weapons. We are working hard to finalize both how they look and how they function. Not to mention how they feel.[/p][p]The Railgun and Launcher weapons will have full makeovers at some point, but currently we're giving some extra care to the trusty Converter.[/p][p][/p][h2]Areas[/h2][p]Some of you sneaked your way into the unfinished areas. We were very impressed, but as stated in the patch notes, we had to limit entry to those places since they're still Work In Progress. We can't go spoiling the surprise for you. However, we're working hard to finish up those areas and hopefully you'll be able to revisit them soon in an upcoming update :)[/p][p][/p][h1]That's all for this update![/h1][h3]Thanks again for playing our demo, stay tuned![/h3][p]dofhouse loves you <3[/p][p][/p][p]Jacob // dofhouse[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: What's Next? THE FUTURE OF AMICA
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/ffa6bc438210f51a80e8f8c3dbd5fa7098b1c4bf.png[/img]

It has now been 1 week since we launched the first version of the Project: AMICA Demo and we are incredibely happy to see so many of you enjoying our game.

We've got tons of great feedback and we're working on fixing a lot of the issues reported, as well as tailoring the gameplay experience to our playerbases wishes.

Here's a list of stuff we've gotten reports about!
[list]
[*] Shotgun feels weak
[*] Lack of lighting in Mines & Canyon
[*] Lack of Secrets
[*] Players being able to access WIP areas
[*] Automap not saving between areas
[*] Lack of notifying a player being close to a new area
[*] Hud refresh rate is wrong
[/list]

We'll be working these issues along with any other feedback we've received.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/9531db6cabe8d361f14d30b67103b907370931ef.png[/img]

Our main focus aside from fixing issues and working with our feedback, is to [b]keep updating the demo with more content[/b]. Before entering Early Access, we want to work and update our demo as "ACT 1". As time goes, we'll rework weapons, animations and Enemies and push these tweaks to the Demo as patches/updates. We're planning on releasing the WIP areas that some of you already found once we feel confident enough.

There's also a Boss being worked on for the first Act. Be ready to revist the demo and find new areas, routes and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45266879/50c0ffff71bf1618a2031a8acb04d11bd16b4f9a.png[/img]

Project: AMICA is an interconnected experience where you'll be revisiting areas you've already explored, but with new power-ups and weapons as you progress through the game. So even if ACT 1 is a set of areas contained within that act, don't be surprised to find yourself back in the ACT 1 areas once you've reached further in the game. 

Our goal is to release Project: AMICA into Early Access once we're done with ACT 2, and keep working on ACT 3 as Early Access progresses.

We're currently looking for a potential publishing partner and/or investor to help further develop our game. We have $0 in budget and are developing the game whenever we have spare time. Our dream is to be able to work full-time on AMICA and finding a publishing partner would help us do so!

Thank you all so much for playing, you'll hear from us soon!
Jacob // dofhouse

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce the release of our first Steam Demo for [b]Project: AMICA[/b]

After a year in development, we finally felt confident in letting players try out Project: AMICA.
It's hard making a game in such an old engine like GZDoom, especially when it's our first time, but we like the challenge!

This demo only shows a small portion of what's to come. Our main focus is tying everything together, the world, levels, more enemies, weapons and stuff. We're also working on the narrative of the game. How are we gonna present it? We have all this lore for the overall world of Project: AMICA but we couldn't really find a way to tie it in to the demo at this stage of development. So we focused on giving players a taste of the gunplay and explorative nature of our game.

We'd love to hear some of your feedback and if there are any bugs or issues please let us know!

dofhouse loves you <3
